README.md:
# example.com/acme/shop

Requires Go 1.27.2 and Gonex v0.0.0. Gonex is a library dependency; you do not need its source checkout. The development CLI is tracked by the tool directive in go.mod.

```sh
go mod tidy
go tool gonex create module users
go tool gonex check
go tool gonex run
```

HTTP defaults to 127.0.0.1:8080. GET /healthz returns {"status":"ok"}; GET /openapi.json exports OpenAPI 3.1. Set HTTP_ADDRESS to override. Ctrl+C stops gracefully. Set GONEX_DISABLE_OPENAPI=1 to disable the public document.

Modules live in modules/, HTTP schemas in http/schemas.go. Business services use plain Go dependencies. Generated registries and .gonex.json belong to Gonex; other files are yours. All generators support --dry-run and refuse overwrites. Persistence is opt-in with --db; configure DATABASE_URL and explicitly run go tool gonex db migrate before serving.
go.mod:
module example.com/acme/shop

go 1.27.2

require github.com/amkargar/gonex v0.0.0

// Project-local development CLI; not linked into the application binary.
tool github.com/amkargar/gonex/cmd/gonex
modules/users/http/openapi.go:
package adapter

const summary = "Read the users message"
